notes: Zen transcripts read like the Claude app: the model's prose never folds. Every paragraph renders full size where it streamed, and each run of tool calls between paragraphs folds into one row titled by the calls ("Read 3 files · Searched for tokens", "Ran the tests (1 failed)"); expanding it lists each call as a step, thinking stays a step, a thinking-only group reads Thought. groupTurnItems keeps prose out of every group, buildActivityPhases drops the prose headline, TurnView folds a group once the turn moves past it. Non-zen unchanged.
